targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  h.host_name,
  t.canonical_nodeid,
  t.test_name,
  LOWER(tr.status) AS status,
  tr.failure_tag AS "Failure Tag",
  TO_CHAR(tr.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AS started_at,
  TO_CHAR(tr.finished_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AS finished_at,
  tr.duration_ms
FROM test_results tr
JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id
JOIN tests t ON t.id = tr.test_id
WHERE tr.run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND h.host_name = '${host}'
  AND tr.test_id = ${test_id}
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  concat_ws(
    E'\n\n',
    CASE WHEN tr.full_trace IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('[full_trace]\n', tr.full_trace) END,
    CASE WHEN tr.captured_log IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('[captured_log]\n', tr.captured_log) END,
    CASE WHEN tr.captured_stdout IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('[captured_stdout]\n', tr.captured_stdout) END,
    CASE WHEN tr.captured_stderr IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('[captured_stderr]\n', tr.captured_stderr) END
  ) AS logs
FROM test_results tr
JOIN hosts h ON h.id = tr.host_id
JOIN tests t ON t.id = tr.test_id
WHERE tr.run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND h.host_name = '${host}'
  AND tr.test_id = ${test_id}
LIMIT 1;

list.definition: SELECT run_id AS __value, CASE WHEN run_name = TO_CHAR(started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') THEN run_name ELSE CONCAT(run_name, ' (', TO_CHAR(started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), ')') END AS __text FROM test_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AND (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to}/1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') ORDER BY started_at DESC
